newsitem.title: USA: Westmark gets $8 mln offer for Green World.
newsitem.headline: Westmark gets $8 mln offer for Green World.

text.p: Westmark Group Holdings Inc said it received an unsolicited offer to sell its Green World Technologies unit for $8 million in cash and notes.
The company said the unidentified potential buyer is a firm with offices in New York and Florida. Westmark bought Green World in July for $1.3 million, it said.
In the event of a sale, Westmark said it would be able to retain a 30 percent interest in Green World if it converts its notes into equity.
The company said its board will discuss the matter in January.
